manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Titan must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Yannik until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
